card.name: Middle of the word contraindicated
card.fires_on: The piece "ain" inside the split word "contraindicated", right after "contr", in label statements such as "X is contraindicated in patients with...".

modes.label: Drug is contraindicated
modes.description: The word is split as contr + ain + dicated after a drug name and "is" or "are".
modes.example: Ketorolac tromethamine is contr<<ain>>dicated as prophylactic analges

card.plain: It fires in the middle of the word "contraindicated" when a label says a drug must not be used.
